incidents.summary: P1: Payment service 500 errors - complete outage for payment processing
incidents.description:
Production payment service is returning HTTP 500 errors for all payment requests. Customers unable to complete purchases. Revenue impact estimated at $45,000/minute. Alert triggered at 14:03 UTC. On-call SRE paged.

Initial investigation: Errors started approximately 1 minute after the 14:02 UTC deployment of payment-service v2.4.2. CloudWatch logs show DB connection pool exhaustion on postgres-primary.

Affected endpoint: POST /api/v2/payments
Error rate: 94.2%
P99 latency: 30,247ms

comments.author: sarah.chen@company.com
comments.body: Confirmed: All payment requests failing with 500. CloudWatch shows HikariCP pool exhausted (50/50 connections). Deployment at 14:02 likely culprit. Investigating connection pool config changes in v2.4.2 PR.

comments.author: mike.johnson@company.com
comments.body: Found it. PR #1847 increased connection pool max_lifetime from 600000ms to 3600000ms and changed minimum-idle from 10 to 0. With minimum-idle=0, the pool doesn't pre-warm connections. Under load, all 50 connections are acquired simultaneously causing the DB server to hit its max_connections limit of 100 (with 50 already used by read-replica traffic).

comments.author: sarah.chen@company.com
comments.body: Initiating rollback to v2.4.1. ETA 10 minutes. Also requesting DBA to review postgres-primary connection limits.

comments.author: ops-bot
comments.body: Rollback complete. Payment service v2.4.1 deployed. Error rate back to 0.1%. Incident partially resolved, post-mortem required.

incidents.summary: P3: Intermittent payment timeouts during peak hours
incidents.description: Intermittent timeout errors seen during peak traffic (12:00-14:00 UTC). Error rate stayed below 5%. Connection pool utilization reaching 80-90% during peaks. Not enough to trigger full outage but impacting user experience.
incidents.resolution: Increased connection pool max-size from 30 to 50. Monitoring shows no more timeouts.

comments.author: mike.johnson@company.com
comments.body: Root cause: Connection pool max-size (30) too small for peak traffic. Increasing to 50. PR #1847 in progress.
